fields.Institution: Department of Business and Sustainability, TERI School of Advanced Studies
fields.Fees — Published:
2026 academic/institutional total ₹13.25 L: one-time ₹35,000; four semester tuition charges ₹3.10 L, ₹3.10 L, ₹3.15 L and ₹3.15 L; examination ₹10,000 each semester. Refundable deposits, hostel and personal expenses are additional.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 13.25
fields.Fee Scope: Derived sum of one-time, tuition and examination charges in the official 2026 four-semester MBA row. Hostel/living costs and refundable deposits excluded.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT / MAT / GMAT / CMAT / XAT, or the TERI SAS entrance examination. Candidates with more than two years of relevant work experience may receive an entrance-test exemption at the selection committee’s discretion.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, including recognised open/correspondence degrees, with English at 10+2 level. The official full-time MBA eligibility section does not state a minimum percentage; the separate online MBA has different requirements.
fields.Selection Process: Shortlist using CAT/GMAT/MAT/CMAT/XAT or TERI SAS entrance test; applicants with more than 2 years of relevant work may be exempted at committee discretion. Final selection through group discussion and interview.
fields.Placement — Published: 85–90% of placement opt-ins across TERI SAS programmes received offers in 2025; not MBA-only
fields.Placement Scope: MBA Sustainability own 2025/26 mean not disclosed. University PG two-year median 8.5 L (2024–25) pools multiple degrees.
fields.Top Recruiters: KPMG; GIZ; HCL; Infosys; Schneider; TATA; UNDP (institution-wide logos, not MBA-exclusive)
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: ESG Analyst; Sustainability Consultant; Climate/Green Finance; Policy & Infrastructure Projects
fields.Notes: University PG two-year median ₹8.5 L is a pooled proxy, not an MBA mean. Current official MBA placement coordinator verified. Course-page ₹8.4 L median (2023) may be relabelled university data. | Final audit: Official 2026 academic charges total ₹13.25 L, replacing the older approximate ₹11.90 L. The separate online MBA’s 50% and three-year experience requirements do not apply to this full-time programme. University two-year PG median ₹8.5 L remains a pooled proxy, not an MBA mean. No programme-specific salary distribution was recovered.
fields.Fee Evidence: Indexed official 2026 fee PDF: one-time ₹35,000 + tuition ₹3,10,000 + ₹3,10,000 + ₹3,15,000 + ₹3,15,000 + four examination charges of ₹10,000 = ₹13,25,000.
